text:
june: Quick sync — we need to pick a small, customer-driven observability mini-MVP for next sprint. Core asks from pilot: lightweight dashboard template, low-friction trace hook, per-route cost slice, and error->trace jump links. Can we scope to ship behind a flag in 1 week?
rahul: Feasibility: backend cost tagging + route metadata exists in proto, but per-route aggregation UI is missing. Trace hook requires header capture (prefer `X-RW-Trace`) and safe storage. Error jump link = format standardization + link builder.
tess: Two prioritization axes: developer effort vs risk (PII, retention). My suggestion: prioritize features that are read-only UI surfaces over new capture pipelines. That means: 1) Build dashboard + links to existing traces/logs, 2) Add header capture toggle but default OFF, 3) Defer long-term retention policy work to follow-up.
mike: For launch criteria propose compact list: 1) Hosted dashboard template (cost, err rate, traces) with one-click add for customers; 2) Trace header capture behind flag + trace_id displayed in error details; 3) Per-route 7d cost rollup for Hosted only; 4) Error details include a jump-to-trace link when trace exists; 5) Canary plan + rollback play.
june: Risk notes: storage/egress costs for traces and accidental PII capture. Legal needs to sign off on default capture settings. Also watch sampling defaults to avoid bursty retention.
rahul: Implementation plan: cost UI component -> reuse billing API, ETA Wed. Trace capture work -> small middleware + DB field, ETA Thu. Error-link plumbing -> trivial, ETA Thu EOD. QA + canary Fri. Will gate on `obs-mini-v0` flag.
tess: Sampling: set default sampling to 0.01% (configurable at org level). Add a quick admin UI to bump sampling for pilot customers only. Also add a retention knob (30d default for pilot).
mike: Rollout: feature flag + staged canary in us-west-2 then eu-west-1. Monitor token-level cost and trace volume via dashboard. Add alert if trace ingress > 2x baseline.
june: Customer ask: can we show Dedicated/Private status as a stub with "coming soon"? Yes — do that so pilot sees roadmap.
ci-bot: Flag created: `obs-mini-v0` — targeting us-west-2 canary group.
june: Action items: rahul PRs + sampling config by Wed, tess mockups by Tue EOD, mike to draft canary runbook. I'll invite pilot contact and legal to review later today. If pilot signs, this becomes top priority.
rahul: Noted. I'll add a safety circuit to drop payloads with potential PII patterns (ssn,email) before storing traces.
tess: UX: keep dashboard template minimal and mobile-friendly. Use a compact cost sparkline + error-rate heatmap + recent traces list.
mike: Acceptance checklist suggestion: 1) Feature flag present and toggled for pilot; 2) Dashboard renders with real pilot data; 3) Trace header captured when flag ON; 4) Error->trace link opens trace UI; 5) Legal sign-off recorded.
june: Great. If pilot flakes we revert to capture-only (no UI) and move per-route cost to follow-up. Posting this summary to roadmap doc and will follow with PR links.
